content.summary: 大伴古麻呂 comes from Tang and reports to the court the New Year audience at 蓬萊宮含元殿 and the seating-order dispute, in 天平勝寶六年正月 (754). The entry names no place; the record anchors the act at the court's seat, 平城宮, as a display anchor.

time.source_expression: 天平勝寶六年正月丙寅 副使大伴宿祢古麻呂自唐國至

content.editorial_notes: This is the court-side report event, distinct from the audience it describes; the report is the chapter's only account of the audience and is labelled as a self-report there. The day is a sexagenary day (丙寅) and is normalized to the month.

places.note: The entry names no place. A court act happens at the court, whose seat in this period is 平城宮 (the palace of 平城京); the record anchors it there for map readability, not as a source-named site.
